title: Commit message hygiene
prompt: Implement `static string? ValidateMessage(string message)` — return null for a good message (non-empty first line, ≤ 72 chars, no trailing period, doesn't start lowercase) or a short reason string: "empty", "too-long", "trailing-period", "lowercase-start".

tests.name: good
failures
tests.hint: Each failure mode has its own reason — diagnosable messages about messages.
